page: Microsoft Azure D64ds_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DDSv5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8370C processor operating at 2.8 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, supported by a 48 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 256 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4 GB of memory per vCPU. Storage is bundled, featuring 2458 GB of local SSD capacity, and the instance is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores all placing in the top 25%. The Intel Xeon processor's support for AVX-512 and cryptography extensions, such as AES, VAES, and SHA_NI, drives strong results in Passmark CPU extended instructions and encryption tests. Memory performance is also robust, with large-block read and write bandwidth benchmarks ranking in the top tier. However, single-core performance on stress-ng and Geekbench remains in the average tier, indicating that workloads benefit more from parallel execution than single-threaded speed.

Given its balanced resource distribution and high-capacity local SSD, the D64ds_v5 is highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring high resource density and local storage performance without the premium of memory-optimized instances. It is well-suited for database operations, as evidenced by strong Passmark database and Redis SET performance. Other appropriate workloads include software compilation, web serving, and moderate parallel processing tasks like ray tracing and image processing. It is less suitable for large-scale LLM text generation, where performance drops to the bottom 25% due to the lack of GPU acceleration.
description: Microsoft Azure D64ds_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine from the DDSv5 family, powered by a 64-vCPU Intel Xeon 8370C processor running at 2.8 GHz on Microsoft Hyper-V. It features 256 GB of RAM, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, and includes 2458 GB of local SSD storage. The x86_64 architecture supports advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and AES cryptography. Benchmarks reveal strong multi-core processing, memory bandwidth, and database performance, placing it in the top 25% for parallel workloads, while single-core metrics remain average. This server is highly effective for database operations, software compilation, web serving, and parallel processing tasks. It offers a cost-efficient profile for resource-dense workloads that require high-speed local storage but do not require dedicated GPU acceleration.
